dashboard.title: Hello {name}
dashboard.description: Your collections and settlements at a glance.

collect.title: Collect a payment
collect.description: Enter the code shown by the customer and the amount. The customer confirms on their phone.
collect.codeHint: The code is valid for 60 seconds.
collect.amountInvalid: Invalid amount: digits and a decimal separator, 3 decimals at most.
collect.waitingMessage: The customer must confirm the payment with their PIN.
collect.cancelMessage: The customer will no longer be able to confirm it. No amount has been debited yet.
collect.refusedMessage: Payment declined. The customer can check their app.
collect.howMessage: 1. The customer shows their code in the app. 2. You enter the code and the amount. 3. The customer confirms with their PIN. You only see “accepted” or “declined”.

history.title: Collection history
history.emptyMessage: Change the filters or the search.

receivables.title: Receivables
receivables.description: Confirmed payments awaiting settlement after 2 working days.
receivables.totalHint: Settled automatically after 2 working days, or through a payout request.
receivables.emptyMessage: All your receivables have been settled.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: Simulate, then request a payout of your receivables to your bank account.
payouts.amountHint: Gross amount, before commission. Minimum: 20.000 TND.
payouts.amountInvalid: Invalid amount: digits and a decimal separator, 3 decimals at most.
payouts.summaryEmpty: Enter an amount, then run the simulation.
payouts.confirmMessage: The payout will be checked, then sent to your bank account.
payouts.conflict: The simulation has expired or your rate has changed. Run the simulation again.

shop.title: My shop
shop.description: Your shop details, points of sale and team.
shop.changeHint: To change these details, contact the FlexiPay administrator.
